crossRefs.note: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
I will strengthen them in Yahweh; and they will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.

translations.web: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
translations.bsb: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
translations.kjv: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
translations.asv: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely, And thy foot shall not stumble.
